month of the holy souls november is a special time to remember to pray for our dead. each priest in the parish celebrates twelve masses for the holy souls annually. envelopes with forms are for you, to include the names of your departed loved ones are available at the back of b oth churches. we invite you to take an envelope. please return completed list and offering to the collection at mass. alternatively hand in to the parish office or to any one of the priest’s houses. the lists of all dec eased will be placed in f ront of the altar and they will be remembered at all masses during nove mber. a word of thanks from fr. damien lynch - i wish to thank mallow parish pastoral council, the parish clergy and ev erybody who organised, contributed to and attended the mass and get-together to mark my departure from mallow and mourneabbey parishes on wednesday, 21st october. it was wonderful to meet again and see familiar faces, and i’m deeply grateful for all the kind words that were spoken a nd the presentations made. may god bless you all and let us keep one another in our praye rs. fr. damien lynch. mallow
